post.text:
New Alleged Chandelier UFO Image Leaked Online

A newly circulated image, reportedly pulled from a now-deleted post on an Indonesian military Facebook forum bears a striking resemblance to the "Chandelier" UFO popularized by Jeremy Corbell, as well as the earlier star-like image https://t.co/R1aX2CIw05
post.author_description:
UFO & anomalous phenomenon researcher. YouTuber. Host of @anompod. Musician. Co-founder Anomalous Media.

#ufoX

description.description: A blurry, low-resolution image appearing to show a star-shaped object through a green digital interface or Reticle. In the center, a tan/flesh-colored six-pointed star shape is targeted by green tracking brackets. At the top of the frame, there is a green horizontal meter with the number 27 in the middle. The background is a grainy, out-of-focus view of terrain or water.

A black and white image showing an object with five symmetrical spokes, resembling a star or a mechanical component, suspended in the sky against a backdrop of clouds. The image contains geometric black border segments framing the scene.

A grainy thermal or infrared sensor image showing a dark, eight-pointed star-shaped object trailing a faint vapor or wake. The screen features a crosshair in the center and several digital overlays including geographic coordinates, a compass bearing, a timestamp, and technical flight data labels typically seen on a military-style head-up display (HUD).
description.ocrText: ACFT 29°09'41.4"N 49°26'56.7"E LRP LRP BLK AUTO-ID N AUTO IND 5 > BRG 115 @JeremyCorbell 14:06:17

description.description: A black and white thermal or infrared sensor image showing a dark central object with heat bloom, likely depicting an aircraft or aerial object in flight. The image includes a head-up display (HUD) with technical flight data, coordinates, and system status indicators across the top and bottom of the frame. Red arrows and text from a social media cross-post are visible at the very bottom edge.
